title: Monotonicity of work-tape windows
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $C$ be a configuration on $x$. If all work-tape heads of $C$ lie in $[-s,s]$ and its work tapes are blank outside that interval, then for every natural number $s'\ge s$, all its work-tape heads lie in $[-s',s']$ and its work tapes are blank outside that larger interval.
